The complex anisotropy factors as v²(r−2D_r)/[(r+D_r−iΩ)²(r+4D_r−2iΩ)], so its zero is exactly r=2D_r for v>0. Finite exponential-age quadrature independently matches formulas across twelve parameter tuples (84 checks). The analytic generator derivation, not quadrature, proves all-parameter identities.

value.rationale: The sharp rate r=2D_r eliminates centered spatial covariance anisotropy for every angular chirality and every isotropic thermal translational noise level, even while reset headings are fixed.
